items.detail: All six door/pantry combinations retain the specified 5 x 6 ft block.
Each M186 search either passes its full contract or is explicitly rejected because the pantry blocks the fixed route start/goal gate before grid expansion.
A remains a route obstacle and has zero pantry/route overlap; B remains an obstacle and unassigned.
All tested pantry footprints remain outside the dining room block; the 6-in dining shift is reported separately.
All test rectangles use the 5 x 6 ft (30 sf) kitchen specification; the 5 x 7 ft M04 source mismatch remains disclosed.
